senses.en: Relating to skilled work or an activity done for payment.
Showing the skill and behaviour expected of a trained worker.
Someone trained for skilled work or paid to perform.

ex.en: We hired a professional photographer for our wedding.
ex.zh: 我们为婚礼聘请了一位专业摄影师。

ex.en: Continuous professional development helps teachers adapt their methods to changing student needs and new educational technologies.
ex.zh: 持续的专业发展帮助教师调整教学方法，以适应学生需求的变化和新的教育技术。

tip: 与amateur对比强调职业；形容态度时强调专业得体。

senses.en: Much better or more impressive than usual.
Very unusual or surprising.

ex.en: My grandmother has an extraordinary memory for people's birthdays.
ex.zh: 我奶奶记别人生日的本领特别出众。

ex.en: Recent advances in medical technology demonstrate the extraordinary potential of cooperation between scientists and engineers.
ex.zh: 医疗技术的最新进展展现了科学家与工程师合作的非凡潜力。

tip: 比very good更强调超出寻常，也可指奇特。

senses.en: To mix something by moving a spoon or similar object around.
To cause a strong feeling or reaction.
Excitement or surprise caused by an event or action.

ex.en: Stir the soup gently so it does not stick.
ex.zh: 轻轻搅拌汤，免得粘锅。

ex.en: Documentaries about endangered animals can stir public concern and encourage stronger support for wildlife conservation.
ex.zh: 关于濒危动物的纪录片能够唤起公众的关注，促使人们更加支持野生动物保护。

tip: 过去式stirred、现在分词stirring均双写r。

senses.en: mathematics involving addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division

ex.en: We practised mental arithmetic while waiting for the bus.
ex.zh: 等公交车时，我们练习了心算。

ex.en: Strong arithmetic skills help young adults manage personal budgets and make informed financial decisions.
ex.zh: 扎实的算术能力有助于年轻人管理个人预算，并作出明智的财务决策。

tip: 作名词通常不可数；范围比mathematics窄。

senses.en: to start a business or arrange equipment

ex.en: They set up a small company last year.
ex.zh: 他们去年创办了一家小公司。

ex.en: Help me set up the tent, please.
ex.zh: 请帮我搭帐篷。

tip: set up 表示“建立、安装、创办”。
scene: Two people setting up a tent in a campsite.

senses.en: Fire a gun or another weapon; hit with a bullet
Take photographs or record a film
A new part growing from a plant

ex.en: She learned to shoot arrows at a local club.
ex.zh: 她在当地一家俱乐部学会了射箭。

ex.en: Film crews often shoot documentaries in remote locations to highlight the effects of climate change.
ex.zh: 摄制组常在偏远地区拍摄纪录片，以突出气候变化的影响。

tip: 过去式和过去分词均为shot；shoot at指朝……射击。

senses.en: To slide accidentally, losing balance or leaving a position.
To move or put something somewhere quietly or quickly.
A small piece of paper, or a minor mistake.

ex.en: I slipped on the wet floor but stayed upright.
ex.zh: 我在湿地板上滑了一下，但没有摔倒。

ex.en: Hospitals should keep floors dry to reduce the risk of patients slipping and injuring themselves.
ex.zh: 医院应保持地面干燥，以降低病人滑倒受伤的风险。

col: slip into a room｜悄悄进入房间
a slip of paper｜一张小纸条
a slip of the tongue｜口误
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为slipped，双写p。

senses.en: the production of goods in factories
businesses that provide a particular type of product or service
steady effort and hard work

ex.en: The fishing industry provides jobs for many local families.
ex.zh: 渔业为当地许多家庭提供了工作。

ex.en: Investment in cleaner technology could help heavy industry reduce emissions without significantly lowering production levels.
ex.zh: 投资更清洁的技术可帮助重工业减少排放，同时不显著降低生产水平。

tip: 工业用industrial；勤奋的用industrious。

senses.en: A situation that makes it possible to do something.

ex.en: The school trip gave me an opportunity to try climbing.
ex.zh: 学校旅行让我有机会尝试攀岩。

ex.en: Public libraries provide an important opportunity for residents to develop skills without paying expensive course fees.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆为居民提供了培养技能的重要机会，无须支付昂贵的课程费用。

col: an opportunity to learn｜学习的机会
tip: 常用an opportunity to do，表示做某事的机会。

senses.en: in a way that requires immediate action or attention

ex.en: We urgently need a plumber to fix this leak.
ex.zh: 我们急需一位水管工来修好这处漏水。

ex.en: Governments must urgently address water shortages through improved infrastructure and policies that encourage responsible consumption.
ex.zh: 政府必须通过改善基础设施和鼓励合理用水的政策，紧急应对缺水问题。

tip: 强调事情需要立即处理，而不只是动作做得快。

senses.en: the joint connecting your foot to your leg

ex.en: She twisted her ankle while walking down the steps.
ex.zh: 她下台阶时扭伤了脚踝。

ex.en: Appropriate footwear can reduce the risk of ankle injuries during physical exercise and outdoor activities.
ex.zh: 合适的鞋子可以降低体育锻炼和户外活动中脚踝受伤的风险。

tip: ankle指脚与小腿连接处，不是脚后跟heel。

senses.en: A wide, open container for water or washing.
The land drained by a river and its smaller rivers.
A broad area of low land surrounded by higher ground.

ex.en: She filled the basin with water to wash her face.
ex.zh: 她往盆里倒满水，准备洗脸。

ex.en: Agricultural expansion across the river basin has increased pressure on freshwater supplies and damaged natural habitats.
ex.zh: 整个流域内的农业扩张加大了淡水供应压力，并破坏了自然栖息地。

tip: river basin指整个流域，不只是河道。

senses.en: To stop something happening or someone doing something.

ex.en: This tight lid will prevent the soup from spilling.
ex.zh: 这个严实的盖子能防止汤洒出来。

ex.en: Investing in early health education can help prevent chronic diseases and reduce future pressure on public healthcare services.
ex.zh: 投资早期健康教育有助于预防慢性病，并减轻公共医疗服务未来的压力。

col: prevent someone from doing｜阻止某人做某事
tip: 用prevent sb from doing，不用prevent sb to do。

senses.en: meat from cattle, eaten as food

ex.en: We cooked the beef slowly with carrots and potatoes.
ex.zh: 我们把牛肉和胡萝卜、土豆一起慢炖。

ex.en: Reducing beef consumption could lower greenhouse gas emissions because raising cattle requires substantial land and resources.
ex.zh: 减少牛肉消费可能降低温室气体排放，因为养牛需要大量土地和资源。

tip: 表示食物时通常不可数：some beef，不用a beef。

senses.en: something that makes success harder or reduces something's value

ex.en: The main disadvantage of this flat is the noise.
ex.zh: 这套公寓的主要缺点是噪声大。

ex.en: Students without reliable internet access face a significant disadvantage when schools rely heavily on online learning.
ex.zh: 当学校高度依赖线上学习时，无法稳定上网的学生会明显处于不利地位。

col: at a disadvantage｜处于不利地位
tip: 表示处于不利地位用at a disadvantage。

senses.en: Extremely good and very enjoyable.
Causing great surprise or admiration.

ex.en: We had a marvellous picnic beside the lake.
ex.zh: 我们在湖边度过了一段美妙的野餐时光。

ex.en: Public gardens offer marvellous opportunities for urban residents to relax and reconnect with nature.
ex.zh: 公共花园为城市居民提供了放松身心、重新亲近自然的绝佳机会。

col: a marvellous achievement｜了不起的成就
tip: 英式拼写为marvellous，美式通常为marvelous。

senses.en: Force air suddenly from your throat with a rough sound.
The act or sound of coughing, or an illness causing it.

ex.en: The dusty room made me cough several times.
ex.zh: 房间里的灰尘让我咳嗽了好几次。

ex.en: People with a persistent cough should seek medical advice, particularly if symptoms interfere with sleep or daily activities.
ex.zh: 持续咳嗽的人应就医咨询，尤其是在症状影响睡眠或日常活动时。

tip: gh在此发/f/；have a cough表示有咳嗽症状。

senses.en: to need, to demand, or to collect someone

ex.en: This difficult task calls for great patience.
ex.zh: 这项艰巨的任务需要极大的耐心。

ex.en: I'll call for you at eight before the party.
ex.zh: 聚会前我八点来接你。

tip: call for 表示“需要/要求”，也可表示“去接某人”。
scene: A clock showing eight while a person waits by the door with a coat.

senses.en: A handled container used for holding and pouring liquids.
The amount of liquid a jug holds.

ex.en: Please bring a jug of water to the table.
ex.zh: 请拿一壶水到餐桌上。

ex.en: Serving tap water in a reusable jug can help restaurants reduce their reliance on disposable plastic bottles.
ex.zh: 用可重复使用的水壶供应自来水，有助于餐馆减少对一次性塑料瓶的依赖。

tip: 英式常指有嘴敞口壶；美式常指窄口带柄罐。

senses.en: Popular or considered attractive at a particular time.

ex.en: Those colourful trainers are fashionable among my friends.
ex.zh: 那种彩色运动鞋在我的朋友中很流行。

ex.en: Consumers often replace fashionable clothing quickly, increasing textile waste and placing pressure on natural resources.
ex.zh: 消费者往往很快就更换时髦的服装，增加了纺织废料，也给自然资源带来压力。

tip: 不仅形容衣服，也可形容观念、活动或地区。

senses.en: an action intended to deceive someone or make them look foolish
a clever technique or an act that seems magical
to deceive someone into believing or doing something

ex.en: Someone played a trick on me with a plastic spider.
ex.zh: 有人用一只塑料蜘蛛捉弄了我。

ex.en: Some online advertisements trick consumers into paying for services they initially believed were free.
ex.zh: 一些网络广告诱骗消费者为他们起初以为免费的服务付费。

col: play a trick on someone｜捉弄某人
trick someone into doing something｜骗某人做某事
the trick to doing something｜做某事的窍门
tip: trick sb into doing sth表示“骗某人做某事”。

senses.en: small enough to hold in your hand

ex.en: He played games on a hand-held device.
ex.zh: 他在手持设备上玩游戏。

ex.en: A hand-held camera filmed the street scenes.
ex.zh: 一台手持摄像机拍摄了街景。

tip: hand-held 是“手持的”，如掌上游戏机。
scene: A small hand-held game device in a person's hands.

senses.en: Tell someone what you think they should do
Officially give someone information about something

ex.en: The doctor advised me to rest for a few days.
ex.zh: 医生建议我休息几天。

ex.en: Schools should advise students on career options before they choose subjects for further study.
ex.zh: 学校应在学生选择进修科目之前，就职业选择向他们提供建议。

col: advise someone to do something｜建议某人做某事
tip: advise是动词；advice是不可数名词，词尾发/s/。

senses.en: The way things actually are, rather than imagined or wished.
Something that actually exists or happens.

ex.en: The holiday looked perfect, but reality was quite different.
ex.zh: 这次假期看起来很完美，但实际情况却大不相同。

ex.en: Although remote work offers flexibility, the reality is that many employees struggle to separate work from personal life.
ex.zh: 虽然远程工作带来了灵活性，但现实是许多员工难以将工作与个人生活分开。

tip: in reality意为“实际上”；a reality指已实现的事。

senses.en: lacking physical strength or energy
not effective, convincing, or well supported
having little intensity, flavour, or power

ex.en: I felt too weak to carry the shopping upstairs.
ex.zh: 我觉得浑身无力，没法把买来的东西提上楼。

ex.en: Policies based on weak evidence may fail to address the underlying causes of unemployment.
ex.zh: 依据薄弱证据制定的政策可能无法解决失业的根本原因。

tip: weak与week同音；weakness可指弱点，也可指虚弱。

senses.en: Someone who teaches at a university or gives educational talks

ex.en: Our lecturer stayed after class to explain the diagram.
ex.zh: 我们的讲师课后留下来讲解那张图。

ex.en: A university lecturer can encourage critical thinking by asking students to compare evidence from different sources.
ex.zh: 大学讲师可以要求学生比较不同来源的证据，从而培养批判性思维。

tip: 某学科的讲师用lecturer in；不等同于教授。

senses.en: to measure how heavy someone or something is
to have a particular weight
to consider something carefully before making a decision

ex.en: Please weigh these apples before putting them in the bag.
ex.zh: 请先称一下这些苹果，再装进袋子。

ex.en: Governments must weigh the economic benefits of tourism against its potential damage to local ecosystems.
ex.zh: 政府必须权衡旅游业的经济收益与其可能对当地生态系统造成的损害。

col: weigh the options｜权衡各种选择
weigh up the evidence｜仔细考虑证据
weigh the benefits against the costs｜权衡收益与成本
tip: weigh是动词，weight是名词；表示重多少不用被动语态。

senses.en: Small in amount or restricted in range

ex.en: We have limited space, so choose a smaller sofa.
ex.zh: 我们空间有限，所以选一张小一点的沙发吧。

ex.en: Students with limited access to reliable internet may struggle to participate fully in online learning.
ex.zh: 难以获得稳定网络连接的学生可能无法充分参与在线学习。

tip: be limited to表示“仅限于”，to后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: Someone who plans how something will look or work.
Made by a famous fashion designer, usually expensive.

ex.en: The designer showed us a model of our kitchen.
ex.zh: 设计师给我们看了我们厨房的模型。

ex.en: A skilled designer can make public spaces more accessible to people with limited mobility.
ex.zh: 技艺娴熟的设计师能够让行动不便的人更方便地使用公共空间。

tip: 作形容词常置于衣物等名词前，强调设计师品牌。

senses.en: Fine thread produced by silkworms, or fabric made from it.

ex.en: She wrapped a soft silk scarf around her neck.
ex.zh: 她把一条柔软的丝巾围在脖子上。

ex.en: Traditional silk production provides employment in rural communities while preserving skills passed down through generations.
ex.zh: 传统丝绸生产为农村社区提供就业机会，同时保留了代代相传的技艺。

tip: silk通常不可数；silky指柔滑如丝，不一定是丝制。

senses.en: To have earned something because of your actions or qualities.

ex.en: You deserve a rest after carrying those heavy boxes.
ex.zh: 搬了那些沉重的箱子后，你该休息一下了。

ex.en: Healthcare workers deserve greater recognition because their dedication contributes directly to the wellbeing of society.
ex.zh: 医护人员值得获得更多认可，因为他们的奉献直接促进了社会福祉。

tip: 接名词或to do；不用deserve doing表示主动。

senses.en: To suggest someone or something as a good choice.
To advise someone that a particular action would be beneficial.

ex.en: Can you recommend a quiet café near the station?
ex.zh: 你能推荐一家车站附近安静的咖啡馆吗？

ex.en: Health experts recommend regular exercise to reduce stress and improve overall physical and mental wellbeing.
ex.zh: 健康专家建议经常运动，以减轻压力并改善整体身心健康。

col: recommend someone for a job｜推荐某人担任某职
tip: 用recommend doing或recommend that从句。

senses.en: money paid in advance, held as security, or banked
to put money or material somewhere for keeping or accumulation
material that builds up naturally in a place

ex.en: We paid a deposit before moving into the flat.
ex.zh: 我们搬进公寓前交了押金。

ex.en: Requiring a refundable deposit on drink containers can encourage recycling and reduce waste in public spaces.
ex.zh: 对饮料容器收取可退还的押金，可以鼓励回收利用，减少公共场所的垃圾。

col: pay a deposit｜支付订金或押金
tip: 订金是预付款；押金作担保；银行存款也用deposit。

senses.en: A distinct part of something larger.
A surface or thin piece exposed by cutting through something.
To divide something into parts or cut it into slices.

ex.en: You'll find fresh bread in the bakery section.
ex.zh: 你可以在烘焙区找到新鲜面包。

ex.en: The final section of the report examines how urban design can encourage healthier lifestyles.
ex.zh: 报告的最后一部分探讨了城市设计如何促进更健康的生活方式。

tip: section可指文章章节，也可指商店等场所的区域。

senses.en: a group of objects kept or presented together
the act of gathering or taking things away
the gathering of money from people for a purpose

ex.en: My aunt keeps her shell collection in a cabinet.
ex.zh: 我姑姑把她收藏的贝壳放在柜子里。

ex.en: Regular household waste collection is essential for protecting public health and maintaining a clean urban environment.
ex.zh: 定期收运生活垃圾对于保护公众健康和保持城市环境整洁至关重要。

tip: a collection of后接复数名词，表示一批相关物品。

senses.en: to arrive or appear somewhere

ex.en: He didn't show up for the meeting.
ex.zh: 他没有出现在会议上。

ex.en: She showed up ten minutes late.
ex.zh: 她迟到了十分钟才露面。

tip: show up 是口语“出现/露面”，等于 turn up。
scene: An empty chair at a meeting table with people waiting.

senses.en: An arrangement to reserve a room, seat, or service.

ex.en: I called the hotel to confirm our booking.
ex.zh: 我打电话给酒店确认我们的预订。

ex.en: Online booking systems allow tourists to compare accommodation prices and plan their journeys more efficiently.
ex.zh: 在线预订系统让游客能够比较住宿价格，更高效地规划行程。

tip: booking是可数名词；预订某项服务常用booking for。

senses.en: Between small and large, or between low and high.
A means of communicating information or expressing ideas.

ex.en: Cook the vegetables over medium heat until soft.
ex.zh: 用中火把蔬菜煮软。

ex.en: Film is an effective medium for exploring social issues and encouraging discussion among young people.
ex.zh: 电影是探索社会问题并促进年轻人讨论的有效媒介。

col: a medium of communication｜传播媒介
tip: 作“媒介”时，复数通常为media。

senses.en: so special or powerful that you will always remember it

ex.en: Watching whales from the boat was an unforgettable experience.
ex.zh: 在船上看鲸鱼是一次难忘的经历。

ex.en: School trips can provide unforgettable experiences that strengthen students' understanding of history beyond the classroom.
ex.zh: 学校组织的旅行能带来难忘的体验，让学生在课堂之外加深对历史的理解。

tip: 形容经历令人难忘；forgetful指人健忘。

senses.en: To promote products, services or events through public messages.
To announce publicly that someone or something is wanted.

ex.en: The bakery advertises its fresh bread on local radio.
ex.zh: 这家面包店在当地电台为自家的新鲜面包做广告。

ex.en: Governments should restrict how companies advertise sugary snacks to children, who may not recognise persuasive marketing techniques.
ex.zh: 政府应限制企业向儿童宣传高糖零食的方式，因为儿童可能无法识别具有诱导性的营销手法。

col: advertise a product｜为产品做广告
advertise for staff｜登广告招聘员工
tip: advertise产品指宣传；advertise for人指登广告招聘。

senses.en: A strip of material wrapped around an injury for protection.
To wrap an injured body part in a bandage.

ex.en: The nurse wrapped a clean bandage around my ankle.
ex.zh: 护士用干净的绷带包住了我的脚踝。

ex.en: Basic first aid courses teach people how to apply a bandage safely before professional help arrives.
ex.zh: 基础急救课程教人们如何在专业救援到来前安全地使用绷带。

tip: 既是名词也是动词；bandage a wound意为包扎伤口。

senses.en: A large tropical fruit with a hard shell and white flesh.
The white flesh of a coconut, used as food.

ex.en: We shared a fresh coconut beside the beach.
ex.zh: 我们在海滩边分着吃了一个新鲜椰子。

ex.en: Coastal farmers can earn additional income by processing coconut shells into useful household products.
ex.zh: 沿海农民可以通过将椰壳加工成实用的家居用品来增加收入。

tip: 指整颗椰子可数，指椰肉通常不可数。

senses.en: a helpful or positive effect of something
to help someone or receive help or an advantage
money provided by the government to people needing support

ex.en: One benefit of cycling is arriving home feeling refreshed.
ex.zh: 骑车的一个好处是到家时感觉神清气爽。

ex.en: Rural communities can benefit from improved internet access through greater opportunities for education and employment.
ex.zh: 更好的互联网接入能增加教育和就业机会，让农村社区受益。

tip: benefit sb指使某人受益；benefit from指得益于。

senses.en: working fewer hours than full time

ex.en: She has a part-time job in a café.
ex.zh: 她在咖啡馆做兼职。

ex.en: He works part time while studying.
ex.zh: 他边学习边兼职。

tip: part time 是“兼职”；反义 full time 全职。
scene: A student serving coffee part time at a café counter.

senses.en: to pay attention to sounds or what someone is saying
to take someone's advice or warnings seriously

ex.en: I listen to music while cooking dinner every evening.
ex.zh: 每天晚上做饭时，我都会听音乐。

ex.en: Local authorities should listen to residents before making decisions that significantly affect their neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 地方政府在作出对社区有重大影响的决定前，应听取居民的意见。

tip: 接对象须用listen to；hear侧重听到的结果。

senses.en: Enough or more than enough of something.
To a sufficient degree or a large extent.
A state in which resources are abundant.

ex.en: There is plenty of soup left for everyone.
ex.zh: 剩下的汤足够大家喝。

ex.en: Although cities offer plenty of employment opportunities, high housing costs can discourage young workers from moving there.
ex.zh: 尽管城市提供大量就业机会，高昂的住房成本仍可能让年轻劳动者不愿迁入。

col: a time of plenty｜富足的时期
tip: plenty of后接复数可数名词或不可数名词，无须加a。

senses.en: Used to express what you hope will happen.
In a way that shows hope.

ex.en: Hopefully, the weather will stay dry for our walk.
ex.zh: 但愿我们散步时天气能保持晴好。

ex.en: Hopefully, improvements in cycling infrastructure will encourage more residents to leave their cars at home.
ex.zh: 希望自行车基础设施的改善能鼓励更多居民放弃开车出行。

col: look hopefully at｜满怀希望地看着
tip: 句首常表示“但愿”，不表示某事一定会发生。

senses.en: things given for winning

ex.en: The winners received their prizes at the ceremony.
ex.zh: 获奖者在典礼上领了奖。

ex.en: There are three prizes for the best projects.
ex.zh: 最佳项目有三个奖项。

tip: prizes 是 prize 的复数，奖品/奖金。
scene: A table with shiny trophies and certificates for winners.

senses.en: A substance used with a toothbrush to clean teeth.

ex.en: I squeezed some toothpaste onto my brush before breakfast.
ex.zh: 早餐前，我往牙刷上挤了些牙膏。

ex.en: Regular brushing with fluoride toothpaste helps prevent tooth decay and can reduce the need for costly dental treatment.
ex.zh: 经常使用含氟牙膏刷牙有助于预防蛀牙，并可减少昂贵牙科治疗的需求。

col: a tube of toothpaste｜一管牙膏
tip: toothpaste不可数；一管牙膏用a tube of toothpaste。

senses.en: the reason for doing something or what something is intended for
a feeling of having meaningful aims in life

ex.en: What is the purpose of this tiny kitchen tool?
ex.zh: 这个小小的厨房工具是做什么用的？

ex.en: The main purpose of public libraries is to provide equal access to information and learning opportunities.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆的主要目的是让人们平等地获取信息和学习机会。

tip: on purpose意为“故意地”，不是“有目的地”。

senses.en: damage to the environment caused by harmful substances or energy

ex.en: Air pollution makes the distant hills difficult to see.
ex.zh: 空气污染让远处的山丘难以看清。

ex.en: Reducing pollution requires governments to regulate industrial emissions while encouraging cleaner transport and more sustainable production methods.
ex.zh: 减少污染需要政府监管工业排放，同时鼓励更清洁的交通方式和更可持续的生产方式。

tip: pollution不可数；具体污染物用pollutant。

senses.en: in or near the middle of a place
extremely important or essential to something

ex.en: Our apartment is central, so we walk to most places.
ex.zh: 我们的公寓位于市中心，因此去大多数地方都步行。

ex.en: Access to reliable information is central to helping citizens make informed decisions about public health.
ex.zh: 获取可靠信息对于帮助公民就公共卫生作出明智决定至关重要。

tip: central to表示“对……至关重要”，介词用to。

senses.en: Someone who manages an organisation, department, or company.
Someone who guides actors and controls a film or play.

ex.en: Our director welcomed the new staff at breakfast.
ex.zh: 我们的主管在早餐时欢迎了新员工。

ex.en: A museum director must balance the need to attract visitors with the responsibility to preserve valuable collections.
ex.zh: 博物馆馆长必须在吸引参观者的需求与保护珍贵藏品的责任之间取得平衡。

tip: 既可指机构主管或董事，也可指影视、戏剧导演。

senses.en: A wheeled chair used by someone who has difficulty walking.

ex.en: She rolled her wheelchair up the ramp into the library.
ex.zh: 她推着轮椅沿坡道进入了图书馆。

ex.en: Public buildings should provide step-free entrances and spacious lifts so that wheelchair users can move around independently.
ex.zh: 公共建筑应提供无台阶入口和宽敞的电梯，让轮椅使用者能够独立通行。

tip: 说a wheelchair user，避免用带有束缚意味的表达。

senses.en: Easy to use or suitable for your needs and plans.
Situated close to somewhere you need to reach.

ex.en: Is Saturday morning a convenient time for your visit?
ex.zh: 你周六上午来方便吗？

ex.en: Online learning offers a convenient way for working adults to develop skills without travelling to a campus.
ex.zh: 在线学习为在职成年人提供了无需前往校园就能提升技能的便捷途径。

col: a convenient way to｜做……的便捷方式
tip: 说 It is convenient for me，不说 I am convenient。

senses.en: having a sharp taste like strong unsweetened coffee
angry and resentful because of unfair treatment or disappointment
involving strong anger and hostility

ex.en: The coffee tasted too bitter without milk or sugar.
ex.zh: 这咖啡不加奶或糖，喝起来太苦了。

ex.en: Proposals to close local libraries have sparked bitter disputes between residents and local authorities.
ex.zh: 关闭当地图书馆的提议引发了居民与地方政府之间的激烈争议。

tip: 味觉上的bitter是苦，sour是酸，别混淆。

senses.en: during the night or for one night
very quickly or suddenly
happening during or lasting for one night

ex.en: We stayed overnight at a small hotel near the station.
ex.zh: 我们在车站附近的一家小旅馆住了一夜。

ex.en: Investment in public transport can improve urban mobility, but meaningful changes rarely happen overnight.
ex.zh: 投资公共交通可以改善城市出行，但实质性变化很少能一夜实现。

tip: 表“一夜之间”时，常强调变化快，不一定真是一夜。

senses.en: All space and everything that exists within it
A complete world of experiences, ideas, or imagined events

ex.en: We watched a film about stars and the universe.
ex.zh: 我们看了一部关于恒星和宇宙的电影。

ex.en: Research into the origins of the universe has driven advances in telescope technology and data analysis.
ex.zh: 对宇宙起源的研究推动了望远镜技术和数据分析的进步。

col: the expanding universe｜不断膨胀的宇宙
the origins of the universe｜宇宙的起源
tip: 指宇宙通常用the universe；开头是辅音音素/j/。

senses.en: The family, education, and experience that shape someone's life
Information or events needed to understand a situation
The part of a scene behind the main subject

ex.en: Her background in nursing helped her care for Grandpa.
ex.zh: 她的护理经历帮助她照顾爷爷。

ex.en: Universities should provide equal opportunities for applicants from different social backgrounds, regardless of their family income.
ex.zh: 大学应为来自不同社会背景的申请者提供平等机会，不论其家庭收入如何。

col: a disadvantaged background｜弱势家庭背景
tip: 经历领域用background in；背景中用in the background。

senses.en: Without anything or anyone coming between.
To guide or control an activity, performance, or group.
To show the way or aim something towards a place.

ex.en: There is a direct train from here to the airport.
ex.zh: 这里有直达机场的火车。

ex.en: Improved public transport can have a direct impact on employment by connecting residents with more job opportunities.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通能让居民获得更多就业机会，从而对就业产生直接影响。

col: direct attention to｜将注意力转向
tip: direct可作形容词或动词；常见读音也有/daɪˈrekt/。

senses.en: armed fighting between countries or groups
a determined effort to defeat something harmful

ex.en: The museum displays uniforms worn during the war.
ex.zh: 博物馆展出了战争期间穿过的军服。

ex.en: War can disrupt children's education and force families to leave their homes in search of safety.
ex.zh: 战争可能打断儿童的学业，迫使家庭离开家园寻求安全。

col: war on poverty｜消除贫困的斗争
tip: 表示处于交战状态用at war，不加冠词。

senses.en: A person who reads, especially books, newspapers, or magazines
A device that displays written material or reads stored information
A book designed to help learners develop reading skills

ex.en: An eager reader, Lina always carries a book.
ex.zh: 莉娜热爱阅读，总是随身带着一本书。

ex.en: Digital libraries allow readers in remote communities to access educational resources without travelling to larger towns.
ex.zh: 数字图书馆让偏远社区的读者无需前往较大的城镇，就能获取教育资源。

col: an avid reader｜热衷阅读的人
tip: reader既可指人，也可指设备或供学习的读物。

senses.en: the land along the edge of a sea or lake
to support something weak or likely to fail, with up

ex.en: We left our shoes on the shore and went swimming.
ex.zh: 我们把鞋留在岸边，然后去游泳了。

ex.en: Construction near the shore should be carefully controlled to protect coastal habitats from permanent damage.
ex.zh: 应严格管控岸边的建设活动，以保护沿海栖息地免受永久性破坏。

tip: shore多指海、湖岸；河岸通常用bank。

senses.en: The process of learning or teaching knowledge and skills.

ex.en: Her grandparents saved money to pay for her education.
ex.zh: 她的祖父母攒钱供她读书。

ex.en: Access to quality education can improve employment prospects and reduce inequality across different social groups.
ex.zh: 获得优质教育的机会能够改善就业前景，并缩小不同社会群体之间的不平等。

col: access to education｜受教育的机会
tip: 通常不可数；但可说a good education（良好教育）。

senses.en: informal word for mother

ex.en: Mum makes the best soup in the world.
ex.zh: 妈妈做的汤是世界上最好喝的。

ex.en: I told my mum about the school trip.
ex.zh: 我把学校旅行的事告诉了妈妈。

tip: mum 是英式说法；美式说 mom。
scene: A mother stirring soup in a kitchen while a child watches.

senses.en: To save someone or something from danger or difficulty.
An act of saving someone or something from danger.

ex.en: Firefighters rescued a kitten from the roof this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上，消防员从屋顶救下了一只小猫。

ex.en: Coastal communities need well-equipped teams to rescue residents when severe flooding blocks roads and damages homes.
ex.zh: 沿海社区需要装备精良的队伍，在严重洪灾阻断道路、损坏房屋时营救居民。

col: rescue someone from｜从……中救出某人
come to the rescue｜前来解围
tip: 常用rescue sb from sth，表示从险境中救出某人。

senses.en: having an even surface without rough areas or bumps
happening without problems, interruptions, or sudden movements
to make a surface even or remove its wrinkles

ex.en: This stone feels smooth and cool in my hand.
ex.zh: 这块石头握在手里又光滑又凉。

ex.en: Clear communication between departments is essential for a smooth transition to a new working system.
ex.zh: 部门之间清晰的沟通对于顺利过渡到新的工作制度至关重要。

tip: 末尾th读浊音/ð/；smoothly常形容事情进展顺利。

senses.en: to feel excited about something in the future

ex.en: I look forward to seeing you next week.
ex.zh: 我期待下周见到你。

ex.en: The children look forward to the school trip.
ex.zh: 孩子们期待学校旅行。

tip: look forward to + 名词/动名词，注意 to 后接动名词。
scene: A child looking happily at a calendar counting down to a trip.

senses.en: a device that controls water flowing from a pipe
to touch or hit something lightly
to use an available source of energy, knowledge, or resources

ex.en: Please turn off the tap while brushing your teeth.
ex.zh: 刷牙时请关上水龙头。

ex.en: Universities can tap local expertise to develop practical solutions to environmental problems affecting nearby communities.
ex.zh: 大学可以利用当地的专业知识，为影响周边社区的环境问题制定切实可行的解决方案。

col: turn off the tap｜关上水龙头
tap someone on the shoulder｜轻拍某人的肩膀
tip: 水龙头在美式英语中常称faucet。

senses.en: Someone competing for a job or an elected position.
Someone taking an examination.

ex.en: Each candidate waited outside the office before their interview.
ex.zh: 每位求职者都在面试前等候在办公室外。

ex.en: Employers should assess each candidate fairly rather than rely on assumptions about their educational or cultural background.
ex.zh: 雇主应公平评估每位求职者，而不是依赖对其教育或文化背景的主观推断。

col: candidate for a position｜某职位的候选人
tip: candidate for后接所竞聘的职位或所竞选的职务。

senses.en: Unhappy because you lack companionship or close connections.
Far from people or rarely visited.

ex.en: I felt lonely until my neighbour invited me for tea.
ex.zh: 我一直觉得孤单，直到邻居邀请我去喝茶。

ex.en: Older adults may feel lonely after retirement, so community centres should provide regular opportunities for social interaction.
ex.zh: 老年人退休后可能感到孤独，因此社区中心应定期提供社交机会。

tip: alone强调独自一人；lonely强调内心孤独。

senses.en: things that belong to a person or organisation
land or buildings that someone owns
a quality of a substance or material

ex.en: Please keep your personal property safe while you swim.
ex.zh: 游泳时，请妥善保管个人财物。

ex.en: Understanding the thermal properties of building materials helps architects design homes that require less heating.
ex.zh: 了解建筑材料的热学性能，有助于建筑师设计供暖需求更低的住宅。

tip: 财产义不可数；房产和性质义可数。

senses.en: not on purpose

ex.en: I took your umbrella by mistake.
ex.zh: 我不小心拿错了你的伞。

ex.en: She deleted the file by mistake.
ex.zh: 她不小心删除了文件。

tip: by mistake 与 by accident 都表示“意外地”；on purpose 是“故意”。
scene: A person holding two umbrellas, realizing one was taken by mistake.

senses.en: a person who makes films

ex.en: The film maker won an award for the movie.
ex.zh: 这位电影制作人因这部电影获奖。

ex.en: She is a young film maker from London.
ex.zh: 她是一位来自伦敦的年轻电影制作人。

tip: film maker 是电影制作者，可指导演/制片人。
scene: A film maker holding a camera on a film set.

senses.en: In or relating to the east of an area.

ex.en: Our hotel overlooks the island's quiet eastern coast.
ex.zh: 我们的酒店俯瞰着岛上宁静的东海岸。

ex.en: Improved railway connections could help eastern regions attract investment and reduce economic differences within the country.
ex.zh: 改善铁路连接有助于东部地区吸引投资，缩小国内经济差距。

tip: eastern通常只作形容词，不表示“东方人”。

senses.en: A distinctive way of doing something or expressing ideas.
The design of something or a fashionable appearance.
To arrange or design something to achieve a particular look.

ex.en: Her colourful paintings have a cheerful, playful style.
ex.zh: 她色彩丰富的画作有一种欢快、俏皮的风格。

ex.en: Modern architects often adapt traditional building styles to preserve local identity while meeting contemporary housing needs.
ex.zh: 现代建筑师常改良传统建筑风格，在满足当代住房需求的同时保留地方特色。

col: style your hair｜给头发做造型
tip: style可指个人风格，不一定表示流行时尚。

senses.en: To raise the corners of your mouth, showing happiness or friendliness.
A facial expression with raised mouth corners, often showing happiness.

ex.en: The baby smiled when I waved across the room.
ex.zh: 我在房间另一头挥手时，宝宝笑了。

ex.en: A friendly smile can help patients feel more comfortable when discussing their concerns with healthcare professionals.
ex.zh: 友善的微笑能让患者在与医护人员讨论自己的顾虑时感到更自在。

tip: 对某人微笑用smile at，不用smile to。

senses.en: A food's flavour, or the sense that detects it.
To try food or drink, or have a particular flavour.
Someone's preferences or ability to judge what is attractive.

ex.en: The soup has a rich taste of roasted tomatoes.
ex.zh: 这汤有浓郁的烤番茄味。

ex.en: Children may develop a taste for healthier foods when schools offer varied and appealing meals.
ex.zh: 学校提供多样且诱人的餐食，可能会让孩子逐渐喜欢上更健康的食物。

tip: taste表示“尝起来”时接形容词，不接副词。

senses.en: a group of similar things held or growing together
a group of people, described informally
to gather closely together, or make things gather together

ex.en: He brought a bunch of flowers for the kitchen table.
ex.zh: 他带来一束花，准备放在厨房的餐桌上。

ex.en: When passengers bunch together near train doors, boarding becomes slower and less comfortable for everyone.
ex.zh: 当乘客聚集在列车门附近时，上车速度会变慢，所有人的乘车体验也会变差。

col: a bunch of grapes｜一串葡萄
a bunch of friends｜一帮朋友
tip: a bunch of可指一束或一串；指人时较口语化。

senses.en: Showing good judgement and practical understanding.

ex.en: Taking an umbrella was sensible in this weather.
ex.zh: 这种天气带把伞是明智的。

ex.en: Investing in preventive healthcare is a sensible way to reduce pressure on public hospitals over time.
ex.zh: 投资预防性医疗是逐步减轻公立医院压力的明智之举。

tip: sensible指明智的；sensitive指敏感的。

senses.en: not certain about something

ex.en: I am unsure about the answer to this question.
ex.zh: 我不确定这道题的答案。

ex.en: She felt unsure about taking the job.
ex.zh: 她不确定是否接受这份工作。

tip: be unsure about/of 是“对…没把握”。
scene: A student hesitating with a hand half-raised in class.

senses.en: a TV drama shown regularly about people's lives

ex.en: My grandmother watches a soap opera every evening.
ex.zh: 我奶奶每天晚上看肥皂剧。

ex.en: The soap opera has been on TV for twenty years.
ex.zh: 这部肥皂剧已经播了二十年。

tip: soap opera 是肥皂剧，剧情连续、贴近生活。
scene: A TV showing a drama scene with a family watching on a sofa.

senses.en: A person trained to compete in sports requiring physical skill.

ex.en: The athlete stretched her legs before the morning race.
ex.zh: 那位运动员在早上的比赛前伸展了双腿。

ex.en: Young athletes need balanced training programmes that protect their health while allowing them to pursue sporting excellence.
ex.zh: 年轻运动员需要均衡的训练计划，在追求卓越运动表现的同时保护健康。

col: a promising young athlete｜有潜力的年轻运动员
tip: athlete常泛指运动员，不只指田径选手。

senses.en: at the greatest distance

ex.en: The furthest town is about fifty kilometres away.
ex.zh: 最远的城镇大约五十公里远。

ex.en: Who can throw the ball the furthest?
ex.zh: 谁能把球扔得最远？

tip: furthest 是 far 的最高级之一（far-farther-furthest）。
scene: A map with a red dot marking the furthest town on a road.

senses.en: a container used to hold flowers or for decoration

ex.en: I put fresh flowers in the vase by the window.
ex.zh: 我把鲜花插进窗边的花瓶里。

ex.en: Traditional pottery, including decorative vases, can provide valuable insights into the artistic practices of past societies.
ex.zh: 包括装饰花瓶在内的传统陶器，可以为了解过去社会的艺术实践提供宝贵线索。

tip: 英式通常读/vɑːz/；美式常读/veɪs/。

senses.en: Wanting to learn or know more about something.
Unusual or strange in a way that attracts attention.

ex.en: The curious kitten peered into my open shopping bag.
ex.zh: 那只好奇的小猫探头看我敞开的购物袋。

ex.en: Teachers can encourage curious students to explore scientific questions through practical experiments rather than memorisation alone.
ex.zh: 教师可以鼓励求知欲强的学生通过动手实验探索科学问题，而不只是死记硬背。

col: a curious mixture｜奇特的混合物
tip: be curious about表示“对……好奇”。

senses.en: To clean and brush an animal or make yourself neat.
A man who is getting married or has just married.
To prepare someone for a particular role or responsibility.

ex.en: We groom our pony every morning before riding.
ex.zh: 我们每天早上骑马前都会给小马梳毛。

ex.en: Some organisations groom promising employees for leadership roles through structured training and regular mentoring.
ex.zh: 一些机构通过系统培训和定期指导，培养有潜力的员工担任领导职务。

col: groom someone for leadership｜培养某人担任领导
tip: 培养某人任职用groom someone for a role。

senses.en: The idea that a word, action, or message communicates.
The importance or purpose that makes something worthwhile.

ex.en: Could you explain the meaning of this unusual word?
ex.zh: 你能解释一下这个不常见的词是什么意思吗？

ex.en: Volunteering can give people a sense of meaning while strengthening connections within their local communities.
ex.zh: 志愿服务既能让人感到生活有意义，也能加强当地社区内部的联系。

col: the meaning of a word｜词义
give meaning to life｜赋予生活意义
tip: 问词义用the meaning of；不要与opinion混淆。

senses.en: The power to direct or limit someone or something.
To direct, manage, or limit someone or something.
A device used to operate a machine or vehicle.

ex.en: Keep control of the kite by holding the string firmly.
ex.zh: 抓紧风筝线，控制好风筝。

ex.en: Stricter control of industrial emissions could improve air quality and reduce health risks in densely populated cities.
ex.zh: 更严格地控制工业排放可以改善空气质量，并降低人口密集城市的健康风险。

tip: 过去式controlled、现在分词controlling均双写l。

senses.en: to do or complete a task

ex.en: The team carried out the plan successfully.
ex.zh: 团队成功执行了计划。

ex.en: Scientists carried out a survey of local birds.
ex.zh: 科学家对当地鸟类进行了调查。

col: carry out a survey｜进行调查
tip: carry out 表示“执行计划、进行调查”等。
scene: Scientists with clipboards observing birds in a field.

senses.en: warm, comfortable, and pleasant, often in a small space
friendly and relaxed in a private setting

ex.en: We spent a cosy evening beside the fire.
ex.zh: 我们在炉火旁度过了一个温暖惬意的夜晚。

ex.en: Small libraries can provide cosy spaces where residents read, relax, and build connections with their neighbours.
ex.zh: 小型图书馆可以提供舒适的空间，让居民阅读、放松并与邻里建立联系。

col: a cosy room｜温暖舒适的房间
tip: 英式拼写cosy，美式通常写cozy。

senses.en: Action taken to protect someone or something from attack or harm.
An argument or explanation supporting someone accused or criticized.
Players or actions that stop opponents from scoring in sport.

ex.en: The thick walls provided a strong defence against attackers.
ex.zh: 厚实的城墙为抵御进攻者提供了坚固的屏障。

ex.en: Restoring coastal wetlands offers a natural defence against flooding while creating valuable habitats for wildlife.
ex.zh: 恢复沿海湿地既能形成防洪的天然屏障，也能为野生动物创造宝贵的栖息地。

tip: 英式拼写 defence；美式拼写 defense。

senses.en: regularly moving, doing things, or taking part
currently working or producing an effect
describing a verb whose subject performs the action

ex.en: My grandfather stays active by swimming every morning.
ex.zh: 我祖父每天早晨游泳，保持活力。

ex.en: Schools should encourage an active lifestyle to improve students' physical health and overall wellbeing.
ex.zh: 学校应鼓励积极运动的生活方式，以改善学生的身体健康和整体身心状态。

col: an active lifestyle｜积极运动的生活方式
play an active role｜发挥积极作用
tip: active指积极活动或参与；不等于表示乐观的positive。

senses.en: boots with blades for ice skating

ex.en: She laced up her ice skates carefully.
ex.zh: 她仔细系好冰鞋鞋带。

ex.en: My ice skates are a bit tight.
ex.zh: 我的冰鞋有点紧。

col: a pair of ice skates｜一双冰鞋
tip: ice skates 是滑冰冰鞋，常用复数。
scene: A pair of white ice skates with blades on an ice rink.

senses.en: money earned for work, often calculated by the hour or week
to carry on a war or organised campaign

ex.en: The café pays a decent wage for weekend work.
ex.zh: 这家咖啡馆给周末上班的员工支付不错的工资。

ex.en: Raising the minimum wage may improve living standards, but small businesses could face higher operating costs.
ex.zh: 提高最低工资可能改善生活水平，但小企业可能面临更高的经营成本。

tip: wage常按小时或周计算；salary通常指固定薪金。

senses.en: To make someone unhappy by failing to meet their expectations.

ex.en: I knew cancelling our picnic would disappoint the children.
ex.zh: 我知道取消野餐会让孩子们失望。

ex.en: Public transport improvements may disappoint commuters if services remain unreliable despite substantial investment in new vehicles.
ex.zh: 尽管大量资金投入了新车辆，若服务仍不可靠，公共交通的改善可能会让通勤者失望。

tip: 人感到失望用disappointed；事物令人失望用disappointing。

senses.en: slightly angry about something unpleasant or inconvenient

ex.en: Leila looked annoyed when the printer jammed again.
ex.zh: 打印机又卡纸了，莱拉显得有些恼火。

ex.en: Residents often become annoyed when construction noise continues late into the evening without prior warning.
ex.zh: 如果施工噪声持续到深夜且事先没有通知，居民往往会感到恼火。

tip: annoyed形容人的感受；annoying形容令人恼火的事物。

senses.en: someone who has successfully completed a university degree
to successfully complete a course at a school or university

ex.en: My sister graduated from university and started work nearby.
ex.zh: 我姐姐大学毕业后，在附近开始工作。

ex.en: Many recent graduates struggle to find employment that matches their qualifications in an increasingly competitive labour market.
ex.zh: 在竞争日益激烈的劳动力市场中，许多应届毕业生难以找到符合自身资历的工作。

col: graduate with honours｜以优等成绩毕业
tip: 名词尾音/ət/，动词/eɪt/；毕业于用graduate from。

senses.en: Careful study aimed at discovering facts or developing knowledge.
To study a subject carefully to discover information.

ex.en: I did some research before choosing my new bicycle.
ex.zh: 挑选新自行车之前，我做了一番调查。

ex.en: Research into renewable energy can help governments develop cleaner and more reliable sources of electricity.
ex.zh: 对可再生能源的研究可以帮助政府开发更清洁、更可靠的电力来源。

tip: 名词通常不可数；说a study，不说a research。

senses.en: a place where a road branches off another road
the action of moving around a central point

ex.en: Take the next turning after the small bakery.
ex.zh: 过了那家小面包店，在下一个路口转弯。

ex.en: Poor visibility at this turning increases the risk of accidents for cyclists and other road users.
ex.zh: 这个转弯处视野不佳，增加了骑车者和其他道路使用者发生事故的风险。

col: miss a turning｜错过转弯路口
a turning on the left｜左侧的岔路口
tip: 表示岔路口时主要用于英式英语；也是turn的-ing形式。
